Torregalli — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

One serious, genuine documented incident stands out here: in May 2025, an 18-year-old woman was sexually assaulted at night while walking home along the isolated, tree-lined avenue leading to Torregalli hospital after getting off the tram at the Nenni-Torregalli stop. Press described the stretch as sparsely populated and poorly overseen after dark, near an abandoned barracks. No other notable incidents were found; daytime the area functions as a normal hospital/residential district. Sources checked: Nove da Firenze, sexual assault near Torregalli hospital (May 2025).
